title: Adaptive Action Horizon Selection via Flow-Field Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.24178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimates are important for adaptive execution in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Existing approaches such as Adaptive Action Chunking (AAC) estimate action entropy from multiple sampled action chunks, introducing additional inference cost and capturing both uncertainty within an action trajectory and diversity across alternative strategies. We introduce Divergence-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Action Chunking (DUAC), a post-hoc method that extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA. Building on a closed-form flow-posterior covariance formulation, DUAC derives action-level uncertainty scores from a single generated chunk using Jacobian-vector products, without retraining or multiple endpoint samples. translated_title: 基于流场不确定性的自适应动作视界选择
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性估计对于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的自适应执行至关重要。现有方法如自适应动作分块需要从多个采样的动作块中估计动作熵，这引入了额外的推理开销，并同时捕获了动作轨迹内部的不确定性与不同备选策略之间的多样性。我们提出了基于散度的不确定性感知自适应动作分块，这是一种事后方法，能够从预训练VLA模型的向量场中提取以轨迹为条件的预测不确定性。基于闭式流后验协方差公式，DUAC利用雅可比-向量积从单个生成的动作块中推导出动作级的不确定性分数，无需重新训练或多次端点采样。DUAC与AAC具有很强的相关性，同时捕获了不同的信息：AAC度量的是采样动作块之间的全局离散度，而DUAC度量的是局部不确定性。
tldr: 本文提出DUAC，一种无需重训练的事后不确定性估计方法，通过预训练VLA模型向量场的闭式流后验协方差和雅可比-向量积，仅需单个动作块即可获得动作级不确定性分数，从而实现自适应动作视界选择并避免多次采样的推理开销。
en_tdlr: DUAC is a post-hoc, retraining-free method that extracts action-level uncertainty from a pretrained VLA's vector field using closed-form flow-posterior covariance and Jacobian-vector products from a single action chunk, enabling adaptive action horizon selection without the inference cost of multiple samples.
